name: Spellbound Hearts
source:
"Spellbound Hearts" is a visual novel game that follows the story of Lykos, a vampire trapped in a desolate castle by a powerful spell. Alone and haunted by memories, Lykos encounters Zephyros, a young wizard who enters his domain seeking a drop of his blood to save his village from a plague. 

As their paths intertwine, Lykos and Zephyros embark on a journey of trust, redemption, and love. Guided by their pasts and a shared purpose, they work together to break the curse binding Lykos and to save Zephyros's village.

[Edited from [url=https://funigami.itch.io/spellbound-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Spellbound Hearts》是一款视觉小说游戏，讲述了莱科斯（Lykos）的故事，莱科斯是一个被强大咒语困在荒凉城堡中的吸血鬼。莱科斯孤独且被回忆所困扰，他遇到了泽菲罗斯，一位年轻的巫师，他进入他的领域寻求他的一滴血来拯救他的村庄免受瘟疫。

当他们的道路交织在一起时，莱科斯和泽菲罗斯踏上了信任、救赎和爱的旅程。在他们的过去和共同目标的指引下，他们共同努力打破束缚莱科斯的诅咒并拯救泽菲罗斯的村庄。

[编辑自[url=https://funigami.itch.io/spellbound-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
